response.answer: BATALEON PLACEBO 2027 — PRODUCT RESEARCH FACT SHEET --- IDENTIFICATION & MODEL INFO --- 1. brand: Bataleon [1][3] 2. model_name: Placebo [1][3] 3. model_year: 2027 (FW 2026/27 season) [3][4] 4. model_first_available_year: Brand new model for the 2027 season — first year of production [3] 5. product_type: Snowboard [1] 6. board_category: Freestyle–All Mountain [3][13] 7. gender: Men's [16] 8. Design note: Ditches 3BT (Triple Base Technology) to offer a more direct, traditional feel; no 3D tech [3][4] 9. Design philosophy: Bataleon's first venture into the "Second Dimension" — a board without their signature 3BT [4][25] 10. predecessor_model_name: Building on the progression that began with the redesigned Goliath a few seasons ago [3] --- MANUFACTURER --- 11. manufacturer: Low Pressure Studio (LPS), Amsterdam, Netherlands — acquired by Nidecker Group in 2018 [43][45] 12. Brand founded: 2000 in the Netherlands by biophysicist Jørgen Karlsen [44][46][48] 13. Brand founding year (DISAGREEMENT): Founded in 2000 per most sources [46][48][50]; some say "late 1990s" [51]; Boardertown says "2001" [44]. Comment: Most credible sources agree on 2000. 14. Brand headquarters: Amsterdam, Netherlands [43][47] 15. Design studio: Low Pressure Studio, Amsterdam [74] 16. manufacturing_location_current: Austria, at the CAPiTA Mothership factory in Feistritz [75][77][79] 17. manufacturing_location_prior: Previously at Elan factory in Austria; temporary production in Asia after Elan's bankruptcy [50][73][74] 18. manufacturing_location_prior: Announced 2014 [77] 19. Nidecker Group is considered the second biggest snowboard company in the world [45] 20. Brand USP: Triple Base Technology (3BT) — though notably the Placebo is the first Bataleon board WITHOUT it [4][47] --- WARRANTY & RETURNS --- 21. warranty: 2-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects from an authorized dealer [84] 22. warranty_period_years: 2+1 year warranty available when registered and subscribed to newsletter [85] 23. return_policy_terms: 45-day returns [84][86] 24. warranty_period_years: Bataleon has a 2 year warranty [18][91] --- SHAPE, PROFILE & DESIGN --- 25. shape: Directional Twin [3][13] 26. Shape description: A symmetrical shape with slightly shifted stance for versatility in freestyle plus stability in one direction [3] 27. camber_type: Medium Camber (camber extends from nose to tail) [3][26] 28. 3D base technology: None — flat base, no 3BT or SideKick [3][4] 29. Nose & tail uplift: None [S2AS product page] 30. Insert location: Centered [S2AS product page] 31. mounting_pattern: 2x4 Inserts [MERCHANT] 32. sidecut_type: Tri-radial sidecut (size-specific multi-radius geometry) [MERCHANT] --- FLEX --- 33. flex_rating_10: 8/10 — Stiff & Aggressive [13][MERCHANT] 34. flex_feel: "Powerful, responsive and built for advanced riding" [13] 35. flex_feel: "mid-stiff flex" [4] — DISAGREEMENT with merchant/S2AS data of 8/10 (stiff). Comment: Boardsport SOURCE's industry preview describes "mid-stiff" whereas retailers list 8/10 (stiff). The manufacturer's own trade press suggests mid-stiff. --- CONSTRUCTION & MATERIALS --- 36. core_material: Light Core — 50/50 Poplar and Paulownia wood blend [MERCHANT][13] 37. laminate: Tri-Ax laminate [13][MERCHANT] 38. Fiberglass description: A traditional two-way weave that is light, strong and playful; keeps the board snappy without adding torsional stiffness [9] 39. construction_material_innovation: Carbon Stringers — additional carbon layups strategically placed to fine-tune flex, response, and feel [MERCHANT][13] 40. construction_material_innovation: Central SuperTube — a single hollow carbon cylinder in the core that enhances camber, reduces weight, and increases pop without stiffening torsionally [MERCHANT][9][4] 41. construction_material_innovation: Placed underfoot to disperse pressure from high impact situations and reinforce inserts [MERCHANT][13] 42. sidewall_material: Flex Walls — urethane sidewalls bonded to core for durability and dampening [MERCHANT] 43. sidewall_material: Urethane poured sidewalls offer exceptional shock absorption, reducing chatter and vibration for smoother, more stable ride [92] 44. base_material: Ultra Glide S — 7000-grade sintered, ultra-dense P-tex [3][13] 45. base_type: Premium sintered base reserved for high-end models; packs more molecules into P-tex for toughness and speed [9][14] 46. Insert material: A-grade German stainless steel inserts [92] --- AVAILABLE SIZES & SPECS (STANDARD) --- 47. available_sizes: 153cm, 156cm, 159cm, 162cm [MERCHANT] 48. available_sizes: 160W, 164W [MERCHANT] 49. available_sizes: S2AS lists sizes 149, 153, 159, 160W, 164W [17] — differs from merchant data which lists 153, 156, 159, 162, 160W, 164W. Price (USD, S2AS): $549.00–$563.00 (price has varied between page visits) [17][53] 97. Price (USD, Blauer Board Shop): $559.95 [Blauer Board Shop product page] 98. Price (USD, Boardertown NZ/US store): Listed but price not shown on fetched page [29] 99. availability_status: Ships from UK to USA in 3-5 days [S2AS product page] 100. availability_status: "Re-stocking soon" — currently out of stock [Blauer product page] 101. availability_status: Sold out / "Full restock coming Fall 2026" — directs to local retailers [9] 102. Shipping restriction (Melbourne Snowboard Centre): Only available for shipping within Australia [59] --- RETAILERS & REPUTATION --- 103. Retailer: Surface 2 Air Sports (S2AS) — UK-based authorized retailer, ships internationally; price match guarantee [S2AS product page] 104. Retailer: Blauer Board Shop — Big Bear Lake, CA, USA; established 1975; Shopper Approved reviews [Blauer product page] 105. Retailer: Melbourne Snowboard Centre — local independently owned Australian store [3] 106. Retailer: Boardertown — NZ/Australia retailer with physical stores; 90-day returns, 7-day price promise [Boardertown page] 107. Retailer: Darkside Snowboards — Killington, VT, USA [7] 108. Retailer: Snowboards.eu — Netherlands-based specialist Bataleon dealer [18] 109. Retailer: Ski Pro AZ — does not appear to stock Placebo specifically [10] 110. Manufacturer direct: Bataleon.com (US/EU/CA) — free shipping >$50, 45-day returns, 2+1 year warranty [84] --- BRAND REPUTATION --- 111. Brand reputation (specialist press): Bataleon has experienced steady, healthy growth over the past few years [25] 112. Brand reputation (retailer): S2AS endorses Bataleon Snowboards as some of the best on the market [17] 113. Brand reputation (specialist store): Snowboards.eu says "Bataleon has been doing its own thing since 2003" and provides standard 2 years warranty on all handmade snowboards [18] 114. Brand reputation (snowboarding community): "Bataleon boards are usually like marmite, either you love or hate 'em" [68] 115. Brand market trend: Bataleon is trending; manufacturers are copying their 3BT approach [69] 116. Brand reputation (industry): Nidecker Group (parent) considered second biggest snowboard company in the world [45] --- PLACEBO-SPECIFIC KEY DIFFERENTIATOR --- 117. Key differentiator: First Bataleon snowboard without any 3D base technology [3][4][25] 118. No 3BT significance: This is notable because Bataleon previously stated they have never made a snowboard without a 3D base [47]; the Placebo breaks that tradition. 119. Appeal: Opens Bataleon to riders who prefer traditional camber edge feel [3][14] 120. Industry context: Bataleon's leading focus for 26/27 is the "in-tune freestyle audience," expanded with both twins and directional twins at different base contours [4] --- COMPARABLE PRODUCTS & COMPETITIVE CONTEXT --- 121. comparable_board_cross_brand: Both are versatile all-mountain/freestyle boards; DOA rated as best all-mountain freestyle [99]; DOA uses hybrid camber vs Placebo's traditional camber [96] 122. user_review_forum: "DOA for carving, charging, jumping and stability and Bataleon for easier buttering and forgiveness" [94] — note this comparison is for 3BT boards; the Placebo with no 3BT would feel more similar to the DOA's edge behavior 123. comparable_board_same_brand: Bataleon Tornado 2027 — also 8/10 flex, directional twin, but retains 3BT and costs $628 USD at S2AS [17][62] 124. comparable_board_same_brand: Bataleon Whatever 2027 — softer (5/10 flex), 3BT directional twin, $538 USD [17][60] 125. comparable_board_same_brand: Bataleon Stereo Team 2027 — 6/10 flex true twin, 3BT + SideKick, HyCap Construction, $629.95 at retailers [37][40] 126. comparable_board_cross_brand: Directional twin all-mountain board, popular competitor in the category [99] 127. comparable_board_cross_brand: Rated best overall all-mountain snowboard [99] 128. comparable_board_cross_brand: The Placebo's traditional camber with no 3BT puts it in direct competition with conventional camber freestyle boards from Capita, Burton, Salomon, etc. --- USER EXPERIENCE & FORUM INSIGHTS (Bataleon general) --- 129. user_review_forum: Frequent forum complaint about 3BT boards is reduced edge hold on ice [63] — NOT applicable to the Placebo since it has no 3BT 130. user_review_forum: Experienced riders say 3BT boards "hold an edge like camber" once committed to the turn [63] 131. Placebo advantage: By removing 3BT, the Placebo should address the main complaint about Bataleon boards — reduced edge hold on hard snow — making it suitable for icy conditions 132. Learning curve: 3BT boards require adaptation [68] — the Placebo should NOT require this adaptation period since it uses traditional camber 133. user_review_forum: Some riders love 3BT for catch-free riding, others dislike the feel at higher speeds [70][64] 134. user_review_forum: Forum users note Bataleon bases can scratch up easily [91] 135. positive_aspect: Users praise catch-free riding, edge hold once engaged, playful feel [65] 136. negative_aspect: One user reported delamination on a prior model board within warranty period [87] 137. user_review_forum: One forum poster reports a shop said "they break" — other users dispute this and say quality is high [91] 138. user_review_forum: "Bataleon are a pretty high quality product that I've personally experienced 1st hand" [91] --- CONSTRUCTION DETAILS --- 139. construction_material_innovation: Provide smoother turn entry, improved chatter absorption, and enhanced durability in cold temperatures [40] 140. construction_material_innovation: Reinforced zones beneath binding inserts reduce compression damage risk and improve board longevity [40] 141. laminate: Traditional two-way weave that is light, strong and playful [9] 142. construction_material_innovation: Enhances pop without stiffening the board torsionally — great for jibbing [9] 143. Materials used include wood core, sintered P-Tex bases, triaxial fiberglass, carbon stringers [51] --- MARKET POSITIONING --- 144. Market segment: High-end performance freestyle / all-mountain [13] 145. Price position: Above mid-range; cheaper than Bataleon Tornado ($628) but more than Fun.Kink ($482) and Whatever ($538) at S2AS [17] 146. Market innovation: Bataleon expanding beyond 3BT for the first time, broadening their potential customer base [3][25] 147. Season trend: 24/25 showed strong demand for twin freestyle boards, driven by younger riders [25] 148. Brand strategy: "Bataleon's first-ever foray into the second dimension" [25] --- ADDITIONAL SPECIFICATIONS --- 149. terrain_suitability: Park, Resort, Powder (per S2AS) [S2AS product page] 150. binding_compatibility: Standard 2x4 inserts — compatible with virtually all major binding brands [MERCHANT]

quotelist.quote: The 2027 Bataleon Placebo is a high-performance freestyle weapon built for riders who demand precision, pop and powerful edge control.

citation.reasoning: S2AS is an authorized UK retailer listing the Placebo with full specs and descriptions. Directly supports brand, model, and product type claims.

quotelist.quote: The Bataleon Placebo is a brand new model for the 2027 season, that marks a new direction for Bataleon, ditching 3BT to offer a more direct, traditional feel.
Building on the progression that began with the redesigned Goliath a few seasons ago, it removes all 3D tech from the board and creates a true cambered snowboard.

citation.reasoning: Melbourne Snowboard Centre is the merchant source provided. This is the Australian retailer with full product description, confirming brand-new status and no-3BT design direction.

quotelist.quote: the Placebo is our first venture into the "Second Dimension." Built for those who prefer a flat profile, this all-mountain destroyer features a lively Light Core and a central C.S.T. SuperTube™ for massive pop.
With a mid-stiff flex and reinforced Impact Plates, it's a high-performance ride designed to stomp every landing.

citation.reasoning: Boardsport SOURCE is a respected industry trade publication. Interview with Tom Johnson, Bataleon Global Director of Marketing, provides authoritative brand-level descriptions and strategy. Notes "mid-stiff" flex which is notable vs the 8/10 stiff rating on retail sites.

quotelist.quote: A premium, 7000-grade sintered base reserved for our high-end models.
Central Super Tube, a single Super Tube down the middle of the board enhances pop without stiffening the board torsionally.

citation.reasoning: Official Bataleon website product page for another 2027 model. Technology descriptions (Ultra Glide S, CST, Tri-Ax) are shared across the range and apply to the Placebo. Manufacturer's own tech descriptions are highest authority.

quotelist.quote: Stiff Flex (8/10): Powerful, responsive and built for advanced riding.
C.S.T. Super Tubes: Maximum power transfer and edge response.
Tri-Ax Laminate + Impact Plates: Increased durability for heavy landings.

citation.reasoning: S2AS full product page with detailed specs. Confirms flex rating, construction details and terrain classifications.

quotelist.quote: The Ultra Glide S premium 7000-grade sintered base is engineered for elite performance, exclusively used in high-end model snowboards.

citation.reasoning: Melbourne Snowboard Centre product description confirming base material specification.

quotelist.quote: Bataleon Placebo Snowboard 2027 - Men's

citation.reasoning: Blauer Board Shop product listing confirms gender designation as Men's and price at $559.95.

quotelist.quote: 2027 Bataleon Placebo Snowboard · Sale price$549.00 · 149153159160W164W

citation.reasoning: S2AS collection page showing price and available sizes for the Placebo, as well as lineup pricing for comparison with other Bataleon models.

quotelist.quote: Bataleon has been doing its own thing since 2003.
Bataleon provides standard 2 years warranty on all their handmade snowboards.

citation.reasoning: European specialist Bataleon dealer confirms warranty period and brand history. Third-party confirmation of manufacturer claims.

quotelist.quote: Bataleon's leading focus for 26/27 is the in-tune freestyle audience.
We're extremely excited to release this collection with an all-new 3BT™ story, an updated SideKick™ story, and Bataleon's first-ever foray into the second dimension.

citation.reasoning: Industry trade press preview with direct Bataleon marketing director quotes. Confirms strategic positioning and Placebo as first non-3BT board.

quotelist.quote: Shop Bataleon Placebo Snowboard 2027 in Multi at Boardertown.

citation.reasoning: Boardertown NZ listing confirms the product is available at this retailer with colour "Multi."

quotelist.quote: Flex Walls – Urethane sidewalls provide smoother turn entry, improved chatter absorption, and enhanced durability in cold temperatures.
Impact Plates – Reinforced zones beneath the binding inserts reduce the risk of compression damage and improve board longevity.

citation.reasoning: Blauer's Stereo Team listing describes Bataleon shared technologies (Flex Walls, Impact Plates) used in the Placebo. Cross-referencing tech descriptions from same lineup.

quotelist.quote: Dennis Dusseldorp and Danny Kiebert have ran Bataleon from the Dutch capital and grown Low Pressure Studio into a major player in the industry.

citation.reasoning: Official Bataleon blog post confirms Amsterdam headquarters and Low Pressure Studio parent company.

quotelist.quote: Founded in 2001, Bataleon Snowboards is a pioneer in snowboard development thanks to the innovation of 3D shaped snowboards.
The story of Bataleon Snowboards begins in Norway, where bio-phycisist and Bataleon co-founder Jorgen Karlsen began looking at the bio-dynamics of snowboarding.

citation.reasoning: Boardertown's in-depth brand history article. Notes founding in 2001, which conflicts with other sources saying 2000. Provides background on Jørgen Karlsen.

quotelist.quote: In 2018, the Nidecker Group acquired the Dutch-based company Low Pressure Studio, owners of Bataleon, Lobster, and Switchback.
It is considered the second biggest snowboard company in the world.

citation.reasoning: Wikipedia article on Nidecker Group confirms the 2018 acquisition of Low Pressure Studio (Bataleon parent) and the Nidecker Group's market position.

quotelist.quote: Bataleon Snowboards was founded in 2000 by then 44-year-old biophsysicist Jorgen Karlson in the Netherlands.

citation.reasoning: Onboard Magazine (snowboarding specialist media) brand profile confirming founding year and founder.

quotelist.quote: We have never made a snowboard without a 3D base because we believe it is the key to more fun and better performance on the mountain.

citation.reasoning: Boardsport SOURCE interview with Bataleon co-founders for 20th anniversary. The quote about never making a non-3D board makes the Placebo's flat base historically significant — it breaks their own long-standing tradition.

quotelist.quote: Bataleon Snowboards was established in 2000 in the Netherlands by a 44-year-old biophysicist Jorgen Karlsen.
All boards from Bataleon Snowboards are manufactured in Austria.

citation.reasoning: Super-Shop retailer brand page confirms founding year and Austrian manufacturing.

quotelist.quote: Up until its closure, Bataleon Snowboards produced all of their boards at the Elan factory in Feistriz, Austria.

citation.reasoning: Fan blog with historical information about Bataleon manufacturing history. Useful for historical context but lower credibility as a WordPress fan site.

quotelist.quote: Bataleon was founded in the late 1990s by Jørgen Karlsen, a Dutch biophysicist and passionate snowboarder.
It's featured on their men's snowboards manufactured in Europe, specifically in Austria, ensuring proven durability.

citation.reasoning: Snowleader European retailer brand page. Notes "late 1990s" founding which slightly differs from other sources. Confirms Austrian manufacturing.

quotelist.quote: On ice that "catch free" turns into "no f'ing edge hold".
The boards are camber and hold a edge like camber.

citation.reasoning: Snowboarding forum discussion about 3BT pros and cons. Shows polarized opinions on edge hold. Relevant context for the Placebo which deliberately removes 3BT to address these concerns.

quotelist.quote: In steep, firm snow you feel a little less edge control but depending in the model, they can still fully shred.

citation.reasoning: Forum discussion with nuanced views on 3BT edge hold. Provides experiential context for understanding why Bataleon created the Placebo without 3BT.

quotelist.quote: On groomers it holds an edge confidently at moderately higher speeds, but still lets you cruise and mess around without feeling locked in.

citation.reasoning: Official Bataleon reviews page showing positive customer feedback. Note: these are on the manufacturer's own site and likely curated, so credibility adjusted downward for selection bias.
